title: Shark Attacks
text:
The Global Shark Attack File (GSAF) is a research database of reported shark-human incidents. Its records include details such as where an incident occurred, what activity was taking place, and the reported outcome. This site uses a cleaned version of those records to explore patterns.
Shark encounters can be serious, but attacks are uncommon. Dramatic stories are easy to remember and often receive wide attention, which can make the danger feel more common than it is; for most people, the actual risk is low.
Use Map to compare recorded attacks across countries. Trends compares fatal and non-fatal attacks by activity for activities with at least 50 incidents, leaving out records with unknown outcomes.
